title: MICA: Multi-granularity Intertemporal Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Emotional Support Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2603.06194v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) has shown strong performance in single-turn tasks, but extending it to multi-turn interaction remains challenging due to sparse rewards and poor per-turn credit assignment. In emotional support dialogues, responses shape future user states, so matched-state step-wise comparison is unavailable, while trajectory-level supervision is insufficient. We propose MICA (Multi-granularity Intertemporal Credit Assignment), a critic-free RL framework for multi-turn emotional support tasks. MICA derives both immediate and delayed credit from a shared potential function over the user's structured support state. Incremental Distance Reward measures the per-turn decrease in residual distance to the target state, while its Monte Carlo return captures delayed effects. translated_title: MICA：面向长程情感支持对话的多粒度跨时信用分配
translated_abstract: 面向大语言模型（LLM）的强化学习（RL）在单轮任务中表现出色，但由于奖励稀疏且逐轮信用分配能力不足，将其扩展到多轮交互仍然充满挑战。在情感支持对话中，回复会塑造未来的用户状态，因此无法进行匹配状态下的逐步对比，而轨迹层面的监督又不够充分。我们提出了MICA（多粒度跨时信用分配），这是一个面向多轮情感支持任务的无评论家（critic-free）强化学习框架。MICA基于用户结构化支持状态上的共享势函数，同时推导即时信用和延迟信用：增量距离奖励衡量每轮到目标状态剩余距离的减少量，而其蒙特卡洛回报则捕捉延迟效应。经过特定范围的归一化后，这两个信号形成混合优势，从而在无需匹配状态的情况下实现稳定的逐轮优化。
tldr: 提出无评论家强化学习框架MICA，通过共享势函数同时生成即时与延迟两类信用信号，实现情感支持对话中无需状态匹配的稳定逐轮优化。
en_tdlr: MICA is a critic-free RL framework that derives both immediate and delayed credit from a shared potential function over the user's structured support state, enabling stable per-turn optimization for multi-turn emotional support dialogue without matched-state comparison.
